items.title: Extract done-effects.ts DONE merge and worktree cleanup from story_advance.ts
items.context: Move the full DONE merge/cleanup pipeline into a new packages/main/src/core/done-effects.ts (or layering-correct location): DONE worktree context detection, pre-merge stray file check, metadata commit, merge of the story branch into main, worktree removal, branch deletion, and failure-message shaping. Mechanical relocation — preserve the exact current step order and all failure semantics. story_advance.ts delegates to done-effects.ts.

items.title: CORE ACCEPTANCE: phase=DONE is never written before merge and cleanup succeed
items.context: This is the central acceptance criterion of the story. The DONE phase must NOT be persisted before the merge + pre-cleanup steps succeed. If merge or any pre-cleanup step fails, the story must remain in its pre-DONE state exactly as the current implementation does — the failure must surface, not be swallowed. Add a regression test that simulates a DONE pre-merge failure and asserts the story did NOT prematurely advance to DONE and the failure message is preserved.

items.title: Regression-prove DONE merge ordering and success path unchanged
items.context: Extend smoke coverage (including worktree-authority-smoke) to prove: successful DONE still merges the story branch to main + removes worktree + deletes branch in the same order; DONE pre-merge failure leaves the story not-prematurely-DONE; failure messages are byte-identical. story_advance.ts no longer contains the inline DONE merge implementation.

items.title: Eliminate globalThis.__koalaDoneChecklistRendered — pass DONE-gate rendered checklist explicitly into done-effects
items.context: Story 3a (B-56d3) left a tech debt: the DONE-gate rendered checklist is stashed on globalThis.__koalaDoneChecklistRendered (set in story-advance.ts ~line 336, read in the DONE return segment). Behavior is equivalent but it is a global-state coupling. Since Story 3b extracts done-effects, the rendered checklist must flow into done-effects as an explicit parameter or return value — remove the globalThis stash entirely. Verify no globalThis.__koalaDoneChecklistRendered reference remains anywhere after extraction.
